product.title: Plaud One
product.description: Create a trustworthy silent 15 second vertical hardware product demo for a Plaud marketer-facing page. This is not a talking avatar video. Do not show narration, captions, subtitles, floating UI, app screens, exaggerated sci-fi effects, invented logos, or text overlays. Show Plaud One as premium wearable earbuds with charging case: case opens on a desk, earbuds lifted by hand, close-up on ribbed case texture, quick on-ear wearing moment, then the case returned to a pocket or work bag. Preserve the white/silver hardware, compact case proportions, rounded earbud shape, ribbed case detail, and real-world scale from the product page. Use clean product photography lighting, steady camera motion, and credible everyday professional context.
